title: Wonderful intimate highlights tour of Sagrada Família
text: Valentina P.   Was a lovely, highly knowledgeable guide for our highlight tour of Sagrada Família.  She shared a chronological and very understandable history of the basilica and Antoni Gaudi and his architectural style and symbolism throughout.  We thoroughly enjoyed Valentina P. And the experience she provided us and would highly recommend this tour.
author: _karenldigian

title: Amazing Sagrada Familia

title: La Sagrada Família and Helena
text: We had a private tour of La Sagrada Família with Helena, our guide. She was an amazing, knowledgeable and personable guide, who explained things clearly, and with great enthusiasm and passion. We have toured La Sagrada Família several times, and each time we learn new details, and come away with a greater appreciation of it all. I would highly recommend this tour, and especially our guide, Helena, who was fluent in both English and Spanish.
author: Freedom00755764877

title: Excellent tour guide
text: Vitaly was an excellent guide with a wealth of knowledge about Sagrada Família. We booked this tour as the regular tickets were sold out and we were so glad we did it. We found out so much information about the history and the development of the building. We look forward to visiting again when it is complete
author: mischa123

title: Sagrada Família Tour
text: Vitaly was fantastic! He is extremely informative and knowledgeable. We really appreciated his passion for history and all of the architecture and the pride he took in the tour! Highly recommended!

title: Private Sagrada Família tour
text: Helena was a wonderful knowledgeable guide whose sincere appreciation of the genius of Gaudí and his masterpiece e shone throughout her tour.   I strongly recommend this tour in general and Helena in particular.
